item.stem:
Misha looks at the diagram. Endpoints $X$ and $Y$ are marked. Points $P$ and $Q$ each lie at the same distance from $X$ as from $Y$. Line $m$ is drawn through $P$ and $Q$.

Which claim correctly names line $m$?

options.A: Line $m$ is the perpendicular bisector of segment $XY$.
options.C: Equal distances from $X$ and $Y$ appear only after line $m$ is already drawn.
options.D: Line $m$ is named by the letter $m$ alone, because $m$ is printed largest.
